info.title: Music Room API
info.description:
REST API of Music Room (Track Vote events, accounts, music search).

**Auth:** log in with `POST /auth/login` (or a social login), then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.
Access tokens last 15 minutes; get a new pair with `POST /auth/refresh`.

**Real-time** (Socket.IO namespace `/events`): see `docs/realtime.md` in the repository.

emailVerified.description: False until the user enters the 6-digit code emailed at registration.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single-use refresh token (7 days). Rotated on every POST /auth/refresh.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT (15 min). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

isrc.description: International Standard Recording Code (same recording across providers).

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working (≈ 15 minutes).

url.description: Signed MP3 link (30 s). Never store it: it expires.

allowed.description: Whether you can vote and suggest tracks right now.

license.description: open = anyone who can see it · invited = owner + invited accounts · geo = inside an area during a time window

myRole.description: Your membership; null = not a member (only possible for public events).

participation.description: For license 'geo' this depends on the location you sent (?lat=&lng=).

isrc.description: International Standard Recording Code (same recording across providers).

suggestedAt.description: Tie-break: at equal score the earliest suggestion plays first.

votedByMe.description: Whether you voted for this track.

id.description: The queue entry's id — use it to vote (not the provider's track id).

upcoming.description: Ranked: score DESC, then suggestedAt ASC.

score.description: The track's score after your request.
